# MKB Corporation

> MKB Corporation describes itself as a research-led real estate investment and wealth advisory firm in India, part of MPB Private Limited.

## About

MKB's published approach emphasizes research, title and cadastral review, physical site verification, infrastructure context, and independent advisory. Website statements describe the firm's services and experience; they are not guarantees of investment outcomes.

## Website

- [Home](https://mkbcorporation.in/): Overview of MKB Corporation and its advisory approach.
- [About](https://mkbcorporation.in/about/): Company background, founder profile, and governance principles.
- [Real Estate](https://mkbcorporation.in/real-estate/): Real estate advisory methodology and published focus markets.
- [Services](https://mkbcorporation.in/services/): Advisory scope and diligence process.
- [Experience](https://mkbcorporation.in/experience/): Published civil engineering and infrastructure experience.
- [Contact](https://mkbcorporation.in/contact/): Contact form and advisory inquiry options.

## Published focus markets

The real-estate page identifies Dholera SIR, Dehradun, the Vizag (Visakhapatnam) corridor, and Bikaner as focus markets. Consult the site for current descriptions and diligence context.

## Important note

MKB's website presents research and advisory information, not a guarantee of returns or a substitute for independent legal, tax, or financial advice. Verify all property, regulatory, and infrastructure information independently before acting.
